$comment: Canonical table policy for the pear-snapshot-v2 export/import format. Every PUBLIC module table must appear in exactly one of `include` or `exclude` — enforced from the TypeScript side (pear/web/src/lib/pearExport.test.ts, against generated bindings) and the Rust side (pear/server/spacetimedb/src/import/pear_v2.rs tests, against the importer dispatch table). Adding a module table without updating this file fails CI on both sides. Private tables are not in client bindings and are intentionally outside this policy (documented in docs/RUNBOOKS/restore-workspace.md).

exclude.id_counter: Module-managed id allocator. import_v2_commit deletes all counter rows so the next allocation re-seeds from post-import max(id) (see id_counters.rs).
exclude.migration_state: Module-managed migration bookkeeping; owned by the module version that publishes, never restored.
exclude.module_install_meta: Module-managed publisher-identity record; re-created by init on the restore target.
exclude.readable_pages: Derived caller-scoped access projection. Recomputed by the module; never restore cached grants.
exclude.readable_components: Derived caller-scoped access projection. Recomputed by the module; never restore cached grants.
exclude.readable_schemas: Derived caller-scoped access projection. Recomputed by the module; never restore cached grants.
exclude.readable_review_snapshots: Derived or transient caller-scoped security state; never restore.
exclude.login_result: Derived or transient caller-scoped security state; never restore.

import_row_guards.component_type_definition: Skip rows with is_builtin == true (re-seeded by init; component_node references types by string, so id drift is harmless).
